The '''''Undying''''' was a large [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] with unknown capabilities. It was larger than the other [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] created with the [[Sun Razer]].

==Description==
Like many [[Capital ship/Legends|capital]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] throughout history, the ''Undying'' had a triangular shape. It had a very broad command bridge on its dorsal surface towards the back of the ship.

==History==
Using the [[Sun Razer]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was able to complete its creation in years instead of decades. All the projects fueled by the Sun Razer were overseen by [[Darth Mekhis]] and discovered by [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]] upon their infiltration and capture in the Vesla system.
